issues.description: Method GroverMultiQubitWithAuxiliaryQubit.simulate: the template implementation declares the return type as list[complex] (statevector) while the exercise text (Exercise 2.6) asks for simulation counts and the reference solution returns a counts dictionary (dict[str,int]). This mismatch will confuse students about whether to return a statevector or measurement counts and can cause tests or type-checking to be misleading.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template method signature to match the intended output: change the simulate signature in template_repository/ex2_grover_multi_qubit_with_auxiliary_qubit.py to def simulate(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) -> dict[str, int]: and adjust the docstring to state that measured simulation counts (a dict mapping bitstrings to frequencies) should be returned. This aligns the template with the problem text and the reference solution and avoids confusion about returning a statevector vs. measurement counts.
